title: Rational rank of an abelian group
statement: For an abelian group $G$, its rational rank is $\operatorname{rrk}(G):=\dim_{\mathbf Q}(G\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q)$, where $\mathbf Q$ is the rational field [def-weil-field], and this is the dimension of the rationalization of $G$.
